name: DFW Fall Warmup 2023
information:
#### *This competition takes place in the afternoon. In the morning, we will have a separate multi-location Fewest Moves competition, [Texas FMC Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasFMCChampionship2023). You can find more information on the [Texas FMC Championship 2023 tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWFallWarmup2023#34317-texas-fmc-championship-2023).*

This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/)

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWFallWarmup2023#34057-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWFallWarmup2023#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 
	
To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
